name: Dade City
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Dade City?
answer_short: Yes, on the city's list. Dade City lets a registered golf cart use specific city streets under Ordinance 2024-01. State and county roads, including US 301, US 98 and SR 52, are not on that list. LSVs may use roads posted 35 mph or less.

golf_cart.roads: The streets named in the city resolution

lsv.notes: Not on a road the city has closed

rules.rule: Registered golf carts on the city streets listed in the resolution under Ordinance 2024-01. Not on state or county roads.
Plain golf carts only on roads a city or county has designated and signed for carts
Registered, insured LSVs on roads posted 35 mph or less; cross faster roads only at intersections

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in Dade City?
faq.a: Roads posted 35 mph or less. Not on a road the city has closed. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Which streets allow a golf cart in Dade City?
faq.a: The city's list includes Sumner Avenue, Martin Luther King Boulevard, the numbered streets from 2nd through 12th, and the avenues named in the registration packet.

faq.q: Can I drive a golf cart on US 301 in Dade City?
faq.a: No. Ordinance 2024-01 does not authorize golf carts on state or county roads.
